'''Sturdy leather leggings''' are the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], crafted from 7 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}
In 1.12.2, the leggings found in [[village]] tannery chests was an older, invisible version of the item. Tannery chests are empty in 1.12.3. See [[Sturdy leather armor#Village tannery chests]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give {{Value|Sturdy Leather Leggings|armor}} armor with {{Value|Sturdy Leather Leggings|durability}} durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection III comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
